lines.translation: I heard of the Guru, and so I went to Him.
He instilled within me the Naam, the goodness of charity and true cleansing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਸਾਰੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mukat hoaa saisaaraRaa naanak sachee beRee chaaR jeeu ||11||
lines.translation: All the world is liberated, O Nanak, by embarking upon the Boat of Truth. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh srisat seve din raat jeeu ||
lines.translation: The whole Universe serves You, day and night.
Please hear my prayer, O Dear Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀਆ ਤੁਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: thok vajaai sabh ditheeaa tus aape laian chhadaai jeeu ||12||
lines.translation: I have thoroughly tested and seen all-You alone, by Your Pleasure, can save us. ||12||
Now, the Merciful Lord has issued His Command.
Let no one chase after and attack anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਵੁਠੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sukhaalee vutheeaa ihu hoaa halemee raaj jeeu ||13||
lines.translation: Let all abide in peace, under this Benevolent Rule. ||13||
Softly and gently, drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
I speak as my Lord and Master causes me to speak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਥਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: bahu maan keeaa tudh upare too(n) aape paaihi thaai jeeu ||14||
lines.translation: I place all my faith in You; please accept me. ||14||
Your devotees are forever hungry for You.
O Lord, please fulfill my desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: dehu daras sukhadaatiaa mai gal vich laihu milaai jeeu ||15||
lines.translation: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Giver of Peace. Please, take me into Your Embrace. ||15||
I have not found any other as Great as You.
You pervade the continents, the worlds and the nether regions;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa naanak bhagataa sach adhaar jeeu ||16||
lines.translation: You are permeating all places and interspaces. Nanak: You are the True Support of Your devotees. ||16||
I am a wrestler; I belong to the Lord of the World.
I met with the Guru, and I have tied a tall, plumed turban.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਛਿੰਝ ਇਕਠੀਆ ਦਯੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: sabh hoee chhi(n)jh ikatheeaa day baithaa vekhai aap jeeu ||17||
lines.translation: All have gathered to watch the wrestling match, and the Merciful Lord Himself is seated to behold it. ||17||
The bugles play and the drums beat.
The wrestlers enter the arena and circle around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਤੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਜੁਆਨ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਪੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਕੰਡਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: nihate pa(n)j juaan mai gur thaapee ditee ka(n)d jeeu ||18||
lines.translation: I have thrown the five challengers to the ground, and the Guru has patted me on the back. ||18||
All have gathered together,
but we shall return home by different routes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh laahaa lai gae manamukh chale mool gavaai jeeu ||19||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs reap their profits and leave, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their investment and depart. ||19||
You are without color or mark.
The Lord is seen to be manifest and present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun tujhai dhiaaide tere bhagat rate gunataas jeeu ||20||
lines.translation: Hearing of Your Glories again and again, Your devotees meditate on You; they are attuned to You, O Lord, Treasure of Excellence. ||20||
Through age after age, I am the servant of the Merciful Lord.
The Guru has cut away my bonds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਛਿੰਝ ਨ ਨਚਊ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਲਧਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: hau baahuR chhi(n)jh na nachaoo naanak ausar ladhaa bhaal jeeu ||21||2||29||
lines.translation: I shall not have to dance in the wrestling arena of life again. Nanak has searched, and found this opportunity. ||21||2||29||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Pehray, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa hukam paiaa garabhaas ||
lines.translation: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you were cast into the womb, by the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: uradh tap a(n)tar kare vanajaariaa mitraa khasam setee aradaas ||
lines.translation: Upside-down, within the womb, you performed penance, O my merchant friend, and you prayed to your Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasam setee aradaas vakhaanai uradh dhiaan liv laagaa ||
lines.translation: You uttered prayers to your Lord and Master, while upside-down, and you meditated on Him with deep love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa marajaad aaiaa kal bheetar baahuR jaasee naagaa ||
lines.translation: You came into this Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and you shall depart again naked.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਲਮ ਵੁੜੀ ਹੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee kalam vuRee hai masatak taisee jeeaRe paas ||
lines.translation: As God's Pen has written on your forehead, so it shall be with your soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai hukam paiaa garabhaas ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command, you enter into the womb. ||1||
